summary: Simvia. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Simvia is an Amsterdam food-supply-chain compliance software company with a team of 65+ people from 28+ nationalities.

culture.text: A team of 65+ people from more than 28 nationalities, building a network that helps food buyers and retailers check safety and sustainability.
It says it manages €100 billion in agricultural goods for clients in 100 countries.
Its 2 open jobs here are mid and senior software engineering roles in Amsterdam.

open.text: Simvia is not an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current postings need no Dutch; they average 113 LinkedIn applicants.
